# Coverage gaps

## Description
What the system has not decided yet, and what to do meanwhile. The page has four components (InstallButton, Logo, HeroScene, TerminalDemo). Everything else on it is plain markup in `app/page.tsx` styled by class in `app/globals.css`.

## Gaps
| Area | Gate | Meanwhile |
|---|---|---|
| Links and navigation | G-07 | Write an `a` with class `link`, as `app/page.tsx:77-78` does in the nav and the footer columns do: 14px, weight 500, `--text`, `--ink` on hover, no underline, 24px tall. The nav holds the brand and two links, which fit 390 wide. A third link needs measuring at 390 first. A link inside a paragraph keeps the browser underline and inherits its color. |
| Other buttons | G-07 | The page has one button, InstallButton. For a second action use a text link as above, or the one bordered `a.cta` block that leads to the docs. If it has to be a button, copy the `.install` rule under a new class name, keep `type="button"` and the shared `:focus-visible` outline, and add a spec from `docs/system/spec-template.md` and a `registry.json` entry in the same change. |
| Cards and mock windows | G-07 | Copy an `article.card` with its `Mock` from `app/page.tsx:120-130`. A card holds an h3, one paragraph of two lines at most, and one mock window, inside `.grid.two`. The mock is `aria-hidden`, so say everything it shows in the paragraph too. |
| Steps | G-07 | Add an item to `STEPS` in `app/page.tsx:20-24`: a title ending in a full stop and one command. The number comes from a CSS counter. |
| Chips | G-07 | Add a name and a logo file to `WORKS_WITH` in `app/page.tsx:13-18`. A chip is a 16px mark and a name in a hairline box, with no link (decision D9). |
| Comparison bars | G-07 | Add a row to `NUMBERS` in `app/page.tsx:28-32`: the question and the characters each search returned, 0 when it found nothing. Each question draws a grep bar and a Bravogram bar on one shared scale, with the number as text beside the bar and the measurement note under them. Every number is measured, with the date and the sample in the note. |
| Questions and answers | G-07 | Add an item to `FAQ` in `app/page.tsx:48-58`. Each is a native `details` with the question in `summary`. An answer is two lines at most at 1440 wide. |
| A new section | G-07 | `section.pad` with an id and one h2, then the content. The h2 is short with no full stop, or `sr-only` when the content explains itself. A boxed block is a `div.tile`. Add a command to the list through `COMMANDS` in `app/page.tsx:36-46`. No body paragraph runs past two lines at 1440 wide. |
| Dark theme | G-08 | There is one theme, light. Write no `prefers-color-scheme` rule and no second value for a color token. |
| Loading, error and empty states | G-08 | The page loads no data and has no form, so it has none. A new section that fetches data needs these decided first: say so in your final message and render the section's static content only. |
| Voice and copy rules | G-08 | There is no writing page yet. Match the page: plain short sentences, sentence case, headings are short with no full stop, numbers come with what was measured and when, no exclamation marks, and dry wit in a section label at most. |
| Imagery | G-08 | The only drawings are the logo, the scene (in the hero and as the footer band) and the graph inside one card. The scene is a memory graph: dots in the six `--graph-*` colors, `--soft` links, and the wordmark and the marks in `--ink`. The six colors appear only there and in the graph card. Add no photos, icon sets, illustrations or third-party logos beyond the chips (decision D9). |
